title: Lentiviral Engineering and Multi-Omic Characterization of Human Kidney Tubuloids
author: Perticari, Ganpat, et al.

steps.title: Section paraffin block
steps.instruction: Place the paraffin block on a cold plate for ~10 min, cut 4 µm slices with a microtome, transfer slices to a 42 °C pre‑warmed water bath using pre‑cooled tweezers, fish the slices onto glass slides, dry the sections for 12–16 h at 37 °C, then bake the slides for 1 h at 60 °C.

steps.title: Deparaffinize and rehydrate
steps.instruction: Incubate the sections twice for 5 min in xylene, then twice for 1 min each in 100 % ethanol, 96 % ethanol, 80 % ethanol, 70 % ethanol, and 50 % ethanol sequentially.

steps.title: H&E staining
steps.instruction: Incubate sections in haematoxylin solution for 2 min, rinse in tap water for 10 min, wash in tap water for 5 min, stain in eosin solution for 30 s, dehydrate by incubating 1 min in 80 % ethanol, 1 min twice in 95 % ethanol, 1 min twice in 100 % ethanol, then 5 min twice in xylene, and finally enclose slides with Pertex.

steps.title: Immunohistochemistry
steps.instruction: Leave slides 5 min in demi water; block endogenous peroxidase in PO‑blocking buffer (15 min, 18‑25 °C) with freshly added H₂O₂; wash 5 min in demi water; perform heat‑induced antigen retrieval by incubating slides 20 min in boiling antigen‑retrieval buffer appropriate for the primary antibody; cool to 18‑25 °C in the same buffer; wash PBS 1X three times (5 min each, replace solution each wash); block with 200 µL of 1 % BSA/PBS 1X per slide for 1 h at 18‑25 °C under humid conditions (cover with plastic coverslip); incubate primary antibody diluted in 0.5 % BSA/PBS 1X (125 µL) at 4 °C for the manufacturer‑recommended time (typically 12‑16 h) covering the slide with a coverslip; wash PBS 1X three times (5 min each); incubate secondary antibody diluted in 0.5 % BSA/PBS 1X (125 µL) for 1 h at 18‑25 °C and cover with a coverslip; wash PBS 1X three times (5 min each); add 150 µL of DAB solution 1X per slide and incubate at room temperature for 15 min in a fume hood; stop the DAB reaction by washing slides with demi water for 5 min at 18‑25 °C; counterstain with haematoxylin by dipping slides 4–5 s, then wash running tap water 1 min; dip slides in acidic ethanol 4 × 2 s; wash running tap water 5 min; dehydrate through ethanol series (1 min each in 25 %, 50 %, 70 % ethanol; 1 min twice in 95 % ethanol; 1 min twice in 100 % ethanol); incubate in xylene 5 min twice; and finally enclose slides with Pertex.
